design: Only the uncertainty example is removed from v14 instructions and the example count is updated. Schema, original events, requested model, provider source, settings and rubrics remain fixed.
acceptance: Review every retained and omitted meaning against original source/rubric, preserve errors and ambiguities, no selective retries or adjusted thresholds. Examples are a development intervention, not fresh evidence.
limits: Prompt ablation targets a known development regression. Reused unblinded cases cannot establish held-out generalization. No reconciliation, writes or production adoption.
